settings.question: When does it ship?
settings.answer: By 31 January 2027. This is a pre-order from our first production run. If the date moves, we tell you first and you can cancel for a full refund.

settings.question: Can I cancel?
settings.answer: Yes, any time before it ships, for any reason. Email hello@anityalabs.com with your order number.

settings.question: How long until I notice it?
settings.answer: Most people say two to three weeks for the saffron. Some only notice it on a hard day, or when they forget it.

settings.question: Can I take it with my medication?
settings.answer: Ask your doctor or pharmacist before adding any supplement, especially if you take medication for mood or blood pressure.

settings.question: How do I get 21 Mornings and the app?
settings.answer: Your order email carries a link that sets up your account with your email already in. 21 Mornings waits on the Practice tab until you start it.
